text: This is Rootine. Focus a little. Grow a lot.
Hard to stay focused? Rootine turns your focus time into a garden.
Pick a focus rhythm, from a quick sprint to deep work, and choose a seed. Focus longer to unlock trees.
Stay on task, and your plant grows with the timer. Give up, and it wilts.
Every finished session becomes a plant. Track your minutes, keep your streak, and earn badges.
Spend the coins you earn on a cozy yard, with a house, a fence, and even a cat.
Your A.I. garden helper. Just ask how you are doing, and Rootie sums up your own progress in seconds: your focus time, your streak, and what to work on next.
Plus tasks, friends, a leaderboard, and dark mode.
Rootine. Start growing today. It is free.
